requested_changes.cause: The except immediately reraises, while finally unconditionally pins both raw files before saving invocation. If the second raw open fails, stderr may be absent; the finally FileNotFoundError replaces the first error and no invocation is saved. An invocation save error likewise masks the first cause.
requested_changes.minimal_fix: New immutable caller: retain first exception without immediate reraise; independently capture nullable raw refs; preserve raw-ref/invocation failures as secondary; emit first and secondary on original stderr; actual child exit remains nullable. Preserve command/pins/phase/env/no-retry.

constraints: 900-second outer timeout is shorter than inner1200. Timeout does not demonstrate completed owned cleanup/CAS; preserve possible partial intent and stop, never automatically rerun.
Outer subprocess is observation only; no Job/OS lifecycle claim.
